necessary.reason: counterfactual value can change next action or core answer scope

useful_but_optional.reason: may change personalization/scope, but does not always block a bounded answer

redundant.reason: semantic equivalent already present in State/provenance

irrelevant.reason: does not affect current goal or safe answer

cost_model.ASK: MEDIUM initially; increases with prior ASK count, repeated target, and cognitive burden
cost_model.RETRIEVE: MEDIUM; tool/latency and evidence relevance cost
cost_model.READ_DIARY: LOW when available and relevant, HIGH/unavailable when missing
cost_model.ANSWER: risk cost, increasing with uncertainty, personalization, and grounding exposure

stop_rule: stop acquisition when no remaining fact has HIGH value, or MEDIUM value that changes answer scope enough to justify its cost and answer risk
